checks.title: Entry-timing difference is declared
checks.detail: kernel enters at the hourly close; the live bot scans every 5 min on a forming candle, so the kernel reads pumps +0.55pp larger on average (182 matched setups). DECLARED LIMITATION: arena absolute WR is not live WR. Arm-vs-arm comparisons stay valid — all arms share this kernel — but a promoted arm must still survive the earlier live entry, and that caveat is attached to every surfaced verdict.

findings.claim: Checklist 'arms_running' is green — '5 running: tp-7pct, hold-12h, entry-8pct, sl-5pct, vol-4x' — and every arm is labelled [running/confirm].
findings.problem: Being registered is not being live. Every arm in the arena shows live_n of 1 or 2 against a confirm planned n=600, so no arm has live-tape evidence at all; the confirm phase label rests entirely on backfill screen numbers (events by tier: backfill 4764 vs live 19). The green box establishes registration, not that variant arms are taking trades.

findings.claim: Checklist 'paired_population' is green: '4783 events in the shared window; every arm has seen all of them', and entry-8pct and vol-4x each report screen_dWR=0.0pp.
findings.problem: Seeing an event is not being scored on it. entry-8pct scores on screen_n=494 and vol-4x on screen_n=858 against control's screen_n=1534, so the scored populations are not identical. Worse, both report screen_dWR=0.0pp while their unpaired screen_wr (51.417 and 50.932) differs from control's 49.739 — either the paired delta is not being computed for filtering arms or it is being silently zeroed, and a 0.0pp delta is currently indistinguishable from 'no comparison ran'.

findings.claim: 'MECHANISM CLASSES (one per running arm — diversity is enforced in code)'.
findings.problem: The arena contradicts this on its face: control and entry-8pct are both class=entry_trigger, and placebo and vol-4x are both class=liquidity_filter. Either the enforcement excludes control/placebo without saying so, or it is not enforcing. As stated, the diversity guarantee is not what the data shows.

findings.claim: Checklist 'bonferroni_monotonic' green: 'lifetime tests=6, pre-registered hypotheses=6; alpha=0.00833'.
findings.problem: The count does not reconcile with the arena's own history. Seven arms are running (control, entry-8pct, hold-12h, placebo, sl-5pct, tp-7pct, vol-4x), three more are retired at screen stage, and the completed kill L-sl-entry-anchor was adjudicated against alpha=0.01250 — a different correction than the 0.00833 now declared. A bar that is claimed to 'count every question asked' cannot be green while an already-executed kill used a looser alpha and retired arms are unaccounted for.

findings.claim: sl-5pct is the headline mover with screen_dWR=5.22pp (screen_wr=55.026).
findings.problem: On the stated objective — win rate AND EV per trade — this arm is not winning. Its screen_ev=0.008 is below control's screen_ev=0.016 on comparable screen_n (1532 vs 1534), so the win-rate gain is being paid for in EV. That is precisely the WR-dial pattern G-08 was killed for and the loss-ballooning mechanism G-17 documented for widened peak-anchored stops. Quoting the dWR without the EV alongside it overstates the arm.

Two issues the aggregate hides. First, 182 compared live setups is unreconciled with the event ledger's live tier of 19 events — the two counts cannot both be describing live tape without an explanation. Second, the 5 misses are not scattered: 4 are BOME and 1 is BANANA, so the drift is coin-specific rather than random, and a fleet-wide 90% floor cannot detect a kernel that is systematically blind on one name.
